name: Magnet Media Optimizer – AI powered image enhancement, Missing Alt Text & Convert to WebP
author: Plugin Magnet

sections.description:
Magnet Media Optimizer is an all-in-one AI-powered WordPress image optimizer that enhances your media library by generating smart ALT text, captions, and descriptions — while also converting images to modern formats like WebP for maximum performance.

Created by Plugin Magnet, this plugin merges the best features of “Alt Bot” and “Upload Converter WebP” into a single, powerful image-optimization toolkit.

Improve your website’s SEO, accessibility, and page speed — automatically.

💻 Demo | 🚀 Get The PRO Version | 🛠 Support | 📄 Documentation

✨ Key Features

🔹 AI-Powered ALT Text Generation

Automatically generate meaningful ALT text using:
– AI models
– EXIF metadata
– File names
– Post titles

Supports:
– Bulk generation
– Single generation
– Auto-generation on upload
– Media Library buttons
– Missing ALT finder

🔹 Smart Captions & Description Builder

Enhance media text fields for:
– Better SEO
– Improved content clarity
– Stronger accessibility compliance

AI can generate:
– Image captions
– Image descriptions

🔹 WebP Image Conversion

Automatically convert JPEG/PNG images to WebP on upload.

Includes:
– Bulk conversion tool
– Quality controls
– Non-destructive processing

🔹 Missing ALT Text Scanner

A complete admin UI showing:
– Images without ALT text
– Status indicators
– Quick one-click fixes

🔹 Performance-Focused

  • Lightweight
  • No frontend bloat
  • Optimized for large libraries
  • Compatible with all cache plugins

🔹 Works Everywhere

Fully compatible with:
– Media Library (grid & list)
– Gutenberg
– Elementor
– Divi
– Bricks
– Classic Editor

💎 Pro Features (Optional Upgrade)

Coming soon — can be expanded when you release the Pro version.

  • Advanced AI model selection
  • Batch scheduler for huge libraries
  • AVIF conversion support
  • Custom rules per folder/category
  • Regenerate ALT based on post context
  • Cloud compression
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 8.0 or greater
  • MySQL 5.5.5 or greater, OR MariaDB 10.1 or greater
  • WordPress 6.7 or greater

Installation from WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Magnet Media Optimizer – AI Image Alt Text, Caption & Description Generator or upload the ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. After activation, go to Dashboard → Magnet Media Optimizer to start using the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin.

Installation via FTP

  1. Unzip the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ using an FTP client.
  3. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Navigate to Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  5. Activate Magnet Media Optimizer – AI Image Alt Text, Caption & Description Generator.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use AI to generate ALT text?

Yes. It can use AI, EXIF data, filenames, or post titles — depending on your settings.

Will this overwrite my existing ALT text?

No. The plugin only fills empty values unless you choose to regenerate manually.

Does WebP conversion replace my original images?

No. Original files are kept unless you enable the “replace original” option.

Will this slow down my site?

Not at all. It does not load scripts on the frontend and is optimized for performance.

Is this compatible with page builders?

Yes — 100% compatible with Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg, and all modern builders.

Can I bulk optimize my old images?

Yes. You can bulk-generate ALT text and bulk-convert images to WebP any time.
